name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2012 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2012 record supports: the techniques ATT&CK lists for the objects it ties to 2012, S0143 Flame (published by Kaspersky on 28 May), S0140 Shamoon (only the two ids that cite the 2012 report), G0066 Elderwood (Symantec's Elderwood Project, 6 September) and G0006 APT1 (the April 2012 phishing Mandiant describes), and behavior described by Microsoft's Advisory 2718704 and MSRC's certificate posts, US-CERT's alerts on Anonymous DDoS activity (TA12-024A), web content management exploitation and Adobe's code-signing certificate, Kaspersky's Gauss and Madi reports, Dropbox's July 2012 post, Microsoft's Nitol action and the 2016 indictment over the bank DDoS. No 2012 source prints an ATT&CK id. The two ATT&CK for ICS techniques listed for Flame are in the study's table, not in this layer. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2012.md. Scores: 100 an ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
